title: Concept: Gradle dependency declared with a dynamic version
description: build.gradle declares a dependency notation ending in `N.+`, which accepts every later release of that major, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The build resolves a version that does not appear anywhere in the repository, so review sees one version and the build uses another.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through build.gradle (gradle).
risk: The build resolves a version that does not appear anywhere in the repository, so review sees one version and the build uses another.
